title: Import SRD Objects and Madness reference tables + rules
description: Import the SRD 5.1 Madness and Objects gamemastering sections as five reference tables and five lookupable rule records, preserving source fidelity and fail-closed importer behavior.
design:
Architecture: Add two fail-closed, heading-scoped slices, Madness -> Objects and Objects -> Poisons. Repair the extractor's justified-fragment island handling by treating up to five items as a suspicious outlier when a better-supported structural gutter exists; do not special-case a page number. Extend parseTables with deterministic row reconstruction for Short-Term Madness, Long-Term Madness, Indefinite Madness, Object Armor Class, and Object Hit Points. Add a focused gamemastering-rules parser that emits exactly Madness, Going Mad, Madness Effects, Curing Madness, and Objects while excluding table captions/rows. Wire both slices into runImporter, reserve new rule keys against existing rule keys, and enforce exact expected gamemastering rule/table coverage for the pinned PDF. Regenerate and review the canonical pack and update importer documentation/baselines.

File map: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/extract.ts (column partition fix); sections.ts (anchors); parseTables.ts (five table families); new parseGamemasteringRules.ts (five rule records and exclusions); index.ts/cli.ts/verify CLI (orchestration and exact coverage inputs as needed); importer unit/pipeline tests; srdGeneratedPack.test.ts (canonical baselines and body fidelity); README.md and docs/audits/srd-5.1-rules-section-coverage.md (coverage status); canonical manifest/records generated from vendored PDF.

Tradeoffs: Keep generic parseRules unchanged because the Objects section needs cross-column prose reconstruction and table filtering beyond its heading parser contract. Keep the new parser source-driven and narrow rather than authoring records manually. Any incidental pack changes from the extractor fix must be reviewed explicitly and covered by regressions; unrelated churn is not accepted.
acceptance_criteria:
- Default anchors locate Madness and Objects only at heading positions and fail closed when their following boundary is absent.
- Extracted page 203 preserves left-column then right-column reading order; Objects prose is no longer row-interleaved.
- The importer emits exactly five new table records with reviewed columns, row counts, values, and source pages.
- The importer emits exactly five new rule records: Madness, Going Mad, Madness Effects, Curing Madness, and Objects; rule text excludes table headers/rows and does not bleed into neighboring sections.
- Existing rule keys remain stable; the real importer fails closed on missing/spurious new rule or table coverage.
- The canonical pack is regenerated from the pinned PDF, audit checks pass, and verify:dnd5e-srd-pack reports an exact match.
- npm run verify:worktree passes.
close_reason: Imported five Madness/Objects tables and five rules with fail-closed anchors and exact coverage; canonical pack and all repository gates verified.
